  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Project Manager",
  "description": "Del-York Group is a global community of internationally renowned talent, united in our passion for a prosperous and limitless Africa.

Our playground is Africa, but our influence is global. From cultivating our creativity to extracting our precious metals, we transform raw resources and human capital into refined products ready for the world. We maximize our capabilities to make a significant impact, empowering global businesses and driving progress around the globe. We are the bridge the global business world and Africa, fostering resilient growth and a strong, interconnected future.

Del-York Group is a dynamic conglomerate of diverse companies, preparing and developing talents and resources for the future of industry and public-private partnerships in Africa.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Project Manager

Job Location: Anambra

Employment Type: Full Time

Job Summary


	The Project Manager (State-Based) will lead the planning, coordination, implementation, monitoring, and delivery of a 12-month renewable project within an assigned state.
	The role serves as the state-level focal point for project implementation, coordinating project teams, stakeholders, partners, resources, and activities to ensure delivery against approved objectives, timelines, budgets, quality standards, and reporting requirements.
	The Project Manager will oversee the project from mobilisation and implementation through monitoring, reporting, evaluation, and close-out, while managing risks, resolving operational challenges, and maintaining effective stakeholder relationships.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and maintain the state-level project workplan, implementation schedule, milestones, and activity tracker.
	Lead the day-to-day implementation of project activities and ensure timely achievement of deliverables.
	Coordinate project teams, resources, vendors, partners, and activities to ensure seamless execution.
	Monitor project scope, timelines, deliverables, and dependencies and take corrective action where required.
	Coordinate state-based project teams and provide clear direction on priorities, responsibilities, and deliverables.
	Serve as the key point of contact between Del-York Group, project teams, partners, government stakeholders, and other relevant stakeholders.
	Build and maintain effective relationships with government agencies, community organisations, private-sector organisations, vendors, and project partners.
	Organise and lead project meetings, stakeholder engagements, review sessions, and field activities.
	Track project progress against agreed milestones, KPIs, outputs, and timelines.
	Prepare regular project reports highlighting progress, achievements, challenges, risks, and recommendations.
	Maintain accurate project records, trackers, reports, activity documentation, and evidence of delivery.
	Identify, assess, and manage project risks, operational challenges, and implementation issues, escalating critical matters appropriately.
	Monitor project expenditure in collaboration with Finance and ensure activities remain within approved budgets.
	Ensure compliance with organisational policies, project guidelines, safeguarding requirements, and applicable standards.
	Monitor the quality and effectiveness of project implementation and recommend improvements where necessary.
	Support project evaluation, lessons learned, and close-out activities.
	Perform other responsibilities required to ensure successful project delivery.


Skills and Qualification


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Social Sciences, Development Studies, or a related field.
	Minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in project management, with proven experience managing projects from initiation to completion.
	A well-recognised professional project management certification, such as PMP, PRINCE2, CAPM, or equivalent.
	Proven experience managing teams, stakeholders, budgets, timelines, risks, and project deliverables.
	Experience managing projects across multiple locations or within a state-based structure is an advantage.
	Experience working with government institutions, development organisations, NGOs, international partners, or donor-funded projects is an added advantage.
	Strong project planning, reporting, stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office/Google Workspace and project management tools
	Willingness to travel within the assigned state and other project locations as required.

Our playground is Africa, but our influence is global. From cultivating our creativity to extracting our precious metals, we transform raw resources and human capital into refined products ready for the world. We maximize our capabilities to make a significant impact, empowering global businesses and driving progress around the globe. We are the bridge the global business world and Africa, fostering resilient growth and a strong, interconnected future.

Del-York Group is a dynamic conglomerate of diverse companies, preparing and developing talents and resources for the future of industry and public-private partnerships in Africa.

 Job Position: Project Manager

Job Location: Anambra

Employment Type: Full Time

Job Summary

	The role serves as the state-level focal point for project implementation, coordinating project teams, stakeholders, partners, resources, and activities to ensure delivery against approved objectives, timelines, budgets, quality standards, and reporting requirements.
	The Project Manager will oversee the project from mobilisation and implementation through monitoring, reporting, evaluation, and close-out, while managing risks, resolving operational challenges, and maintaining effective stakeholder relationships.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and maintain the state-level project workplan, implementation schedule, milestones, and activity tracker.

	Coordinate project teams, resources, vendors, partners, and activities to ensure seamless execution.
	Monitor project scope, timelines, deliverables, and dependencies and take corrective action where required.
	Coordinate state-based project teams and provide clear direction on priorities, responsibilities, and deliverables.
	Serve as the key point of contact between Del-York Group, project teams, partners, government stakeholders, and other relevant stakeholders.

	Track project progress against agreed milestones, KPIs, outputs, and timelines.
	Prepare regular project reports highlighting progress, achievements, challenges, risks, and recommendations.
	Maintain accurate project records, trackers, reports, activity documentation, and evidence of delivery.
	Identify, assess, and manage project risks, operational challenges, and implementation issues, escalating critical matters appropriately.
	Monitor project expenditure in collaboration with Finance and ensure activities remain within approved budgets.

	Experience managing projects across multiple locations or within a state-based structure is an advantage.
	Experience working with government institutions, development organisations, NGOs, international partners, or donor-funded projects is an added advantage.
	Strong project planning, reporting, stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office/Google Workspace and project management tools
	Willingness to travel within the assigned state and other project locations as required.

 Job Position: Operations Manager

Job Location: Lagos

Benefits

	Work directly within a growing fashion business
	Develop valuable real-world business experience
	Contribute to meaningful projects and operations
	Learn, grow, and take on increasing responsibility
	Be part of a young and driven team building for the future.

	Ability to interpret financial and operational reports, monitor KPIs, and achieve business targets.
	Excellent communication, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant hospitality or property management systems.


Salary
N300,000 - N400,000 Monthly.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to startupsoarhr@gmail.com using &quot;Application for Hospitality Manager &ndash; Apo, Abuja&quot; as the subject of the email.

Accountant Job at the Nigerian Capital Development Fund (NCDF) Group




        
    

        
        Nigerian Capital Development Fund (NCDF) Group Plc is an impact investor focused on emerging markets. The NCDFGroup acts as a strategic umbrella for a diverse range of emerging ventures, encompassing Financial Technology, Affordable Green Housing & Renewable Energy, Entertainment & Media and Training & Mobility sectors. Our aim is to establish financially viable businesses that solve social and environmental problems.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Accountant

Job Location: Lagos, Nigeria

Role Description
     

            
    




	The Accountant is a full-time, on-site role based in Lagos, responsible for maintaining accurate financial records and supporting effective financial management across NCDF Group.
	The role includes working with international subsidiaries, preparing and posting journal entries, reconciling bank and ledger accounts, managing accounts payable and receivable, and assisting with month-end and year-end closing activities.
	The Accountant will prepare financial reports, support budgeting and forecasting, and ensure compliance with relevant accounting standards, tax regulations, and internal controls.
	Day-to-day tasks also involve monitoring cash flow, supporting audits, responding to internal and external financial queries, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to provide clear financial insights.
	The ideal candidate will contribute to strengthening financial discipline and transparency within the Group’s broader capital and execution platform.


Qualifications


	Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; professional certification (e.g., ICAN, ACA, ACCA) is highly beneficial.
	Relevant experience in corporate, investment, or financial services environments, ideally with exposure to capital markets or institutional platforms.
	Strong core accounting capabilities, including general ledger management, journal entries, reconciliations, and financial statement preparation.
	Proficiency in financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis to support decision-making and performance monitoring.
	Experience with tax compliance, regulatory reporting, and audit support, including familiarity with Nigerian financial regulations and standards.
	Competence in using accounting and ERP software, as well as MS Excel and other analytical tools for data management and reporting.
	Attention to detail, strong numerical and analytical skills, and the ability to maintain accurate, timely records under defined controls.
	Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams and present financial information clearly.


Method of Application
